arrive.text: Morning, after the rain. You wake up. You're a puddle.

fits.text: What an interesting hole you find yourself in. It fits you rather neatly.

made.text: In fact, it fits you so perfectly, it must have been made to have you in it.

sun.text: The sun is coming up. It's getting warmer.

ask.text: Was the hole made to fit you?

cracks.text: There are cracks in the ground, running off to other holes.

other_1.text: This one fits you perfectly, too.

end_home_1.text: You're sure everything will be all right. The world was made for you, after all.

end_home_2.text: So it comes as rather a surprise when you're gone.

end_flow.text: The sun takes you all the same. But you knew, at the end: you took the shape of the hole. Not the other way round.
